name: Hairy Sweat Bee
desc: Hairy Sweat Bee (Lasioglossum pilosum): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 965 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lasioglossum pilosum is a species of sweat bees in the family Halictidae. The species is a generalist and known to pollinate flowers as well as commercial fruits like apples.
